doc.title: PHL TRACON – PCT LOA
doc.summary: LOA between Philadelphia and Potomac TRACONs: route/altitude tables for PHL→PCT and PCT→PHL departures, DOV departures to PHL, TEC charts, ODESA area delegation and satellite airport lists.

items.title: Purpose, cancellation, scope
items.text: Prescribes transfer of control and radar handoff procedures, route/altitude assignments and airspace delegation between Philadelphia TRACON (PHL) and Potomac TRACON (PCT). Cancels the PHL and PCT LOA dated March 19, 2008. Procedures apply unless prior coordination is effected.

items.title: PHL→PCT departures: use Attachment 1, else APREQ
items.text: All aircraft departing PHL TRACON to PCT TRACON shall be cleared to the destination via the routes and altitudes in Attachment 1. Other routes and altitudes are on an APREQ basis.

items.title: ZNY unmanned: BWI/DCA flights to PCT after MXE
items.text: Should New York Center not be manned, flights destined to BWI and DCA will be handed off to Potomac Approach (or Washington Center if Potomac Approach is offline) after passing MXE.

items.title: PCT→PHL departures: use Attachment 2, else APREQ
items.text: All aircraft departing PCT TRACON to PHL TRACON shall be cleared to the destination via the routes and altitudes in Attachment 2. Other routes and altitudes are on an APREQ basis.

items.title: PHL N Sats to BWI/DCA via MXE V378 BAL
items.text: PHL N Sats departures to BWI & Sats / DCA & Sats via MXE V378 BAL: 10,000' jets; 6,000' or 8,000' props. (BWI/DCA satellites not defined in this LOA.)

items.title: PHL/PHL S Sats to BWI/DCA RNAV jets via CLIPR
items.text: PHL & PHL S Sats departures to BWI & Sats / DCA & Sats via DQO V166 BELAY V378 TRISH CLIPR CLIPR STAR: 10,000', RNAV jets only.

items.title: PHL/PHL S Sats to BWI/DCA non-RNAV jets via BAL
items.text: PHL & PHL S Sats departures to BWI & Sats / DCA & Sats via DQO V166 BELAY V378 BAL: 10,000', non-RNAV jets.

items.title: PHL/PHL S Sats turboprops via ENO V16 CHOPS V308
items.text: PHL & PHL S Sats turboprop departures to BWI & Sats / DCA & Sats via ENO V16 CHOPS V308 OTT DCA: 6,000'-8,000'.

items.title: PHL Area to IAD & Sats via V408 ROBRT AML
items.text: PHL Area departures to IAD & Sats via V408 ROBRT AML: 8,000', 210kts or less. (IAD satellites not defined in this LOA.)

items.title: PHL Area TEC via MRB: V408 ROBRT V143 MRB
items.text: PHL Area departures, TEC via MRB, routed V408 ROBRT V143 MRB: 8,000', 210kts or less.

items.title: PCT→PHL jets via V433 DQO: 9,000
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to PHL via V433 DQO: 9,000' jets.

items.title: PCT→PHL via ODESA OOD: 5,000 TP / 4,000 slow
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to PHL via ODESA OOD: 5,000' turboprops; 4,000' for 180kt or less.

items.title: PCT→PHL N Sats jets via V433 DQO: 11,000
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to PHL N Sats via V433 DQO: 11,000' jets.

items.title: PCT→PHL N Sats props via V419/V378 MXE: 5,000
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to PHL N Sats via V419 MXE or V378 MXE: 5,000' props.

items.title: PCT→PHL S Sats via V433 DQO: 5,000
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to PHL S Sats via V433 DQO: 5,000', no restriction.

items.title: PCT→PHL S Sats via V433 DQO: 4,000 if ≤180kts
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to PHL S Sats via V433 DQO: 4,000' for aircraft 180kts or less.

items.title: PCT→LGA turboprops via V433 DQO V479 RUUTH
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to LGA via V433 DQO V479 RUUTH V123 RBV: 12,000' turboprops.

items.title: PCT→EWR turboprops via V433 DQO V479 RUUTH
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to EWR via V433 DQO V479 RUUTH V123 RBV: 11,000' turboprops.

items.title: PCT→EWR pistons via V419/V378 MXE ARD: 5,000
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to EWR via V419 MXE ARD or V378 MXE ARD: 5,000' piston.

items.title: PCT→EWR Sats turboprops via DQO029 V3 SBJ
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to EWR Sats via V433 DQO DQO029 V3 SBJ: 12,000' turboprops. (EWR satellites not defined in this LOA.)

items.title: PCT→EWR Sats pistons via V419/V378 MXE V3
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to EWR Sats via V419 MXE V3 or V378 MXE V3: 5,000' piston.

items.title: PCT→WRI Sats via ODESA OOD V312 CYN: 5,000
items.text: Departures from PCT (printed 'WRI Area') to WRI Sats via ODESA OOD V312 CYN: 5,000', no restriction. (WRI satellites not defined in this LOA.)

items.title: DOV+ requesting >FL180 via MXE J110: 7,000
items.text: DOV and satellite departures requesting above FL180, routed MXE J110: 7,000'. (DOV satellites not defined in this LOA.)

items.title: DOV+ to PHL direct DQO: 7,000
items.text: DOV and satellite departures landing PHL, routed direct DQO: 7,000'.

items.title: DOV+ PHL sats/overflights via ENO V29 DQO
items.text: DOV and satellite departures to PHL satellites and overflights, routed ENO V29 DQO or direct DQO: 5,000' or 3,000'.

items.title: DOV+ landing EVY direct: 3,000
items.text: DOV and satellite departures landing EVY, routed direct: 3,000'.

items.title: DOV+ all via direct ENO: 3,000
items.text: DOV and satellite departures (all), routed direct ENO: 3,000'.

items.title: DOV+ to EWR satellites via V29 MXE V3 SBJ
items.text: DOV and satellite departures to EWR satellites, routed V29 MXE V3 SBJ: 5,000'.

items.title: DOV/PHL area chart: areas A–H altitudes
items.text: Scanned chart (as legible): A South Arrival 7,000 and above, DQO 6,000/below; B South Arrival 7,000 and above, DQO 6,000; C South Arrival 8,000/6,000; D South Arrival 6,000 and above, OOD 5,000/below; E South Arrival 8,000/6,000, ACY 5,000/below. BLARE AREA: F DQO 6,000/4,000; G DQO 6,000/5,000, OOD 4,000; H South Arrival 6,000 and above, OOD 5,000/4,000. Routes: DQO V29 southbound 4,000/6,000; OOD V157 4,000/6,000; from ENO 3,000/5,000, MXE J110 7,000; SR846 entry point shown.

items.title: TEC chart: PCT area to PHL area
items.text: Chart (as legible): V419 5000 and V378 5000 (via TROYZ/NUGGY) toward MXE; TK-504 3000 from RUSEY via CIDOB; V170-214-433-445 from KERNO at 4000-5000-9000 / 11000-12000; via ODESA to OOD 4000 & 5000 landing PHL. Transfer point is the approach control boundary line.

items.title: TEC chart: PHL area to PCT area
items.text: Chart (as legible): TK-502 4000 from SINON toward KITHE/VINNY and via WINGO to TAYLO; V3-408 8000 from MXE; V378 6000-8000-10000 via NUGGY/TROYZ to BELAY; V166 6000-8000-10000 from DQO via CURVY to BELAY/TAFFI. Transfer point is the approach control boundary line.

items.title: ODESA area delegated to PCT: 4,000–9,000
items.text: When PHL delegates the ODESA (shaded) area to PCT, PCT has 4,000 through 9,000 feet. ODESA area coordinates: A 39 34' 24" / 75 53' 55"; B 39 37' 04" / 75 46' 31"; C 39 31' 52" / 75 42' 14"; D 39 24' 48" / 75 48' 15".

items.text: Philadelphia Area North (PHLN): CKZ, DYL, LOM, PNE, PTW, TTN, UKT, N10, N47, 3NJ6, 9N1.

items.title: PHL Area South (PHLS) satellites
items.text: Philadelphia Area South (PHLS): EVY, ILG, MQS, OQN, N57, NJ74, 17N, 58M, 7N7.

items.title: ARD Area satellites
items.text: ARD Area: 3NJ6, CKZ, DYL, UKT, PNE, TTN.

items.title: PTW/DQO Area satellites
items.text: PTW/DQO Area: OQN, 7N7, 58M, PTW, MQS, N10, ILG, N47, N57, LOM, EVY.
